example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একজন দক্ষ কলমবাজ, তার লেখায় সবাই মুগ্ধ হয়।
সংবাদপত্রের এই কলমবাজের কলমে জাদু আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a skilled kalambaz, captivating everyone with his writing.
This newspaper's kalambaz has magic in his pen.
note: Refers to skilled writers in Bengali literary tradition, often journalists or authors.
